TITLE: Manual: How to Leave a Party
TEXT:
HOW TO LEAVE A PARTY (without vanishing)

Option A — The Honest Exit:
"I'm going to head out. Thank you, I had a good time."

Option B — The Gentle Exit:
"Early morning tomorrow. I'm going to slip out."

Option C — The Emergency Exit:
Point at nothing.
Say: "Oh—"
Leave.

Do not:
- apologize repeatedly
- explain your entire nervous system
- wait until you hate everyone

Remember:
Leaving is allowed.
You are not a prop.
You are a person with a threshold.
